description: This file defines the 'AttendancePluginConfiguration' class, which implements plugin configuration for the attendance module within the OrangeHRM system. It sets up dependency injection for the attendance service during plugin initialization.

classes.name: AttendancePluginConfiguration
classes.description: Implements plugin configuration for the attendance module, registering the AttendanceService during initialization.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin by registering the AttendanceService in the container.
